title: 21 Daily Social Media Salon Marketing Ideas (Updated 2024)

facts.fact: The page says research recommends Instagram posting at a frequency of 2-7 times per week (attributed to Hootsuite).
The page says research recommends Twitter posting at a frequency of 1-5 times per day (attributed to Hootsuite).
The page says research recommends Facebook posting at a frequency of 1-2 times per day (attributed to Hootsuite).
The page says research recommends LinkedIn posting at a frequency of 1-5 times per day (attributed to Hootsuite).
The page cites Pew Research Center data stating that 48% of people ages 30-49 use Instagram.
facts.quote: it’s only used by 48% of people ages 30-49

facts.fact: The page advises salon owners to aim to start posting on social media at least once a day, while noting the frequency figures are only recommendations.
facts.quote: Aim to start posting at least once a day and go from there.

facts.fact: The article was published on May 2, 2024, and is titled as updated for 2024.
